provenance: Written against the folded inventory of logs/20260924_0_glm53_flash_b200_tp4_ep4_nsys (Slurm 1068; vLLM fork, GLM-5.3-Flash FP8, B200 x4, TP4/DP1/EP4, chunk 2048, fp8 KV, MTP off) and the glm53_flash_vllm_fp8_kda_dsa_moe cost manifest from timing-predict Slurm 1203 (HEAD 6d60d96). gen_rules.py emits 186 candidates; rules that match no position at the fixpoint were dropped (186 -> 132) with labels verified identical.
note: One order-free rule set: 0 disagreements at the fixpoint, 0 subsumptions. Forward-phase measured kernels are mapped except a few folded-body edge positions; the DSA indexer Inductor k-LayerNorm and weights multiply own dsa.indexer.k_norm / dsa.indexer.weight_scale. The fused_recurrent_kda input copies belong to kda.recurrent_decode (the L1 kind times the whole call). The single sparse-MLA launch of an iteration is dsa.sparse_mla, owning both variant slots, and dsa.glue owns dsa.glue plus the prefill-only dsa.prefill_glue. Preprocess, sample plumbing and bookkeep stay explicitly unmapped. The one exception is the sample-phase lm_head GEMM, which is mapped, and the logits all-gather, which is labeled as an unmapped synchronizing collective. The two remap-buffer fills are labeled as dsa.q_fp8_quant, because the analyzer rejects a slot claimed by two operations present in the same iteration.
